backfill_news.headline: 2026 Holiday Grease Roundup: Free recycling program collects 8,591 gallons
backfill_news.summary: North Texas launched a free FOG collection program running November 1–January 31, 2027, with 51 drop-off stations diverting 100% of collected grease into biodiesel and biogas production through partnerships with American BioSource.
